product_overview: TA Cloud is a thesis management platform for coordinating proposals, supervision, defense requests, grading, final document submission, and academic archiving. It provides separate workspaces for students, lecturers, and study program heads, plus a public library of completed theses.
core_goals: Let students create and manage their own thesis records, upload supporting documents, follow supervision feedback, and submit final materials.
Let lecturers review assigned theses, record guidance, submit defense requests, and publish grades.
Let study program heads manage academic data, assign reviewers, approve workflow requests, and oversee final thesis review.
Let visitors browse the public library of completed theses without signing in.
Let users receive and review in-app notifications tied to thesis workflow activity.

features.name: Institutional Google onboarding
features.description: Users can sign in with an institutional Google account, and the system links or creates an account based on the verified domain.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Start Google sign-in -> Select an institutional Google account -> Return to the app signed in -> See the role-based dashboard
Navigate to /login -> Start Google sign-in -> Select a non-institutional or empty-email account -> See access rejection

features.name: Role-based workspaces
features.description: Signed-in users are routed into the workspace for their role, with access restricted to their own permitted area.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Sign in -> See the workspace for the assigned role -> Open the role-specific navigation area -> Access the permitted workspace pages
Navigate to a different role workspace path directly -> Attempt to open the page -> See access denied or redirection to the allowed workspace

features.name: Student thesis management
features.description: Students can create and update their thesis record, then use it as the central workspace for ongoing thesis activities.
user_flows: Navigate to /mahasiswa/skripsi -> Create a thesis record -> Fill in thesis details -> Save the record -> See the new thesis appear in the workspace
Navigate to /mahasiswa/skripsi -> Open an existing thesis -> Edit thesis details -> Save changes -> See the updated thesis information
Navigate to /mahasiswa/skripsi -> Open an existing thesis -> Review thesis progress and related records -> Continue working from the thesis workspace

features.name: Proposal and revision document uploads
features.description: Students can upload proposal files and later add revision or versioned documents to support thesis progress.
user_flows: Navigate to /mahasiswa/skripsi -> Open an existing thesis -> Upload a proposal document -> Save the upload -> See the proposal version recorded
Navigate to /mahasiswa/skripsi -> Open an existing thesis -> Upload a revision document -> Save the upload -> See the new document version in the thesis history

features.name: Bimbingan history and feedback review
features.description: Students can review supervision history, read lecturer feedback, and track revisions tied to each meeting.
user_flows: Navigate to /mahasiswa/skripsi -> Open an existing thesis -> Open the guidance history -> Review meeting notes and revision feedback -> See the supervision timeline
Navigate to /mahasiswa/skripsi -> Open an existing thesis -> Open the guidance history -> Export the guidance log -> Receive the exported CSV or PDF file

features.name: Final submission workflow
features.description: Students can submit final thesis materials when they are eligible to do so, using the active final submission routes.
user_flows: Navigate to /mahasiswa/skripsi -> Open an eligible thesis -> Start final submission for the available event -> Provide the required final materials -> Submit the form -> See the submission recorded

Navigate to /mahasiswa/skripsi -> Open an eligible thesis -> Open the final document submission area -> Provide the required final thesis files -> Submit the files -> See the final submission status update

features.name: Published grade viewing
features.description: Students can view grades that have been published for their thesis events.
user_flows: Navigate to /mahasiswa/skripsi -> Open an existing thesis -> Open the grades view -> Review published scores and grading details -> See the current assessment results

features.name: Non-thesis record management
features.description: Students can create and manage non-thesis academic records tied to their profile workspace.
user_flows: Navigate to /mahasiswa/non-skripsi -> Create a non-thesis record -> Fill in the record details -> Save the record -> See the record listed
Navigate to /mahasiswa/non-skripsi -> Open an existing non-thesis record -> Update the record details -> Save changes -> See the revised record information

features.name: Lecturer thesis review and guidance
features.description: Lecturers can open assigned theses, review student work, and record supervision notes.
user_flows: Navigate to /dosen/skripsi -> Open an assigned thesis -> Review the thesis detail -> Add guidance notes -> Save the guidance entry -> See the new guidance history
Navigate to /dosen/skripsi -> Open an assigned thesis -> Update an earlier guidance entry -> Save changes -> See the updated supervision record
Navigate to /dosen/skripsi -> Open an assigned thesis -> Remove a guidance entry -> Confirm the action -> See the guidance entry removed

features.name: Lecturer assessment and defense request
features.description: Lecturers can enter grading information for assigned theses and submit defense-related requests.
user_flows: Navigate to /dosen/penilaian -> Open an assigned thesis in the assessment queue -> Enter component scores -> Save the assessment -> See the grade recorded
Navigate to /dosen/penilaian -> Open an assigned thesis in the assessment queue -> Publish the assessment -> See the grade locked in the system
Navigate to /dosen/pengajuan-sidang-skripsi -> Review the request area -> Submit a defense request for the thesis -> See the request enter the approval queue
Navigate to /dosen/penilaian -> Open a locked grade -> Request unlock for the grade -> See the unlock request submitted

features.name: Kaprodi academic administration
features.description: Study program heads can manage lecturers, students, academic periods, assessment formats, and imported user data.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin/dosen -> Create or update a lecturer record -> Save the record -> See the lecturer list updated
Navigate to /admin/mahasiswa -> Create or update a student record -> Save the record -> See the student list updated
Navigate to /admin/import/dosen -> Import lecturer data from a CSV file -> Complete the import -> See the imported records added
Navigate to /admin/import/mahasiswa -> Import student data from a CSV file -> Complete the import -> See the imported records added
Navigate to /admin/tahun-akademik -> Create or update an academic year -> Save changes -> See the academic year list updated
Navigate to /admin/periode -> Create or update an academic period -> Save changes -> See the period list updated
Navigate to /admin/format-penilaian -> Create or update an assessment format -> Save changes -> See the format list updated

features.name: Kaprodi thesis oversight and reviewer assignment
features.description: Study program heads can monitor thesis progress, assign reviewers, and manage oversight decisions for individual theses.
user_flows: Navigate to /kaprodi/skripsi -> Open a thesis record -> Review the thesis overview and current status -> Assign reviewers -> See the reviewer assignment recorded
Navigate to /kaprodi/skripsi -> Open a thesis record -> Update the thesis oversight details -> Save changes -> See the updated thesis status
Navigate to /kaprodi/skripsi -> Open a thesis record -> Schedule or adjust the defense timing -> Save the schedule -> See the defense plan reflected in the thesis record

features.name: Kaprodi proposal approval queue
features.description: Study program heads can review submitted proposals and decide whether to approve or reject them.
user_flows: Navigate to /kaprodi/pengajuan-proposal -> Open a submitted proposal -> Review the proposal details -> Approve the proposal -> See the proposal move forward in workflow
Navigate to /kaprodi/pengajuan-proposal -> Open a submitted proposal -> Review the proposal details -> Reject the proposal -> See the proposal return with a rejection decision

features.name: Kaprodi defense request approval queue
features.description: Study program heads can review thesis-defense requests and decide whether to approve or reject them.
user_flows: Navigate to /kaprodi/permohonan-sidang -> Open a defense request -> Review the request details -> Approve the request -> See the request accepted into the defense workflow
Navigate to /kaprodi/permohonan-sidang -> Open a defense request -> Review the request details -> Reject the request -> See the request closed with a rejection decision

features.name: Kaprodi final document review
features.description: Study program heads can review final thesis documents and decide whether the submission is approved.
user_flows: Navigate to /kaprodi/review-dokumen-final -> Open a final document submission -> Review the final files -> Approve the review -> See the final review approved
Navigate to /kaprodi/review-dokumen-final -> Open a final document submission -> Review the final files -> Reject the review -> See the final review returned for revision

features.name: Kaprodi document template management
features.description: Study program heads can manage final document templates and connect them to academic periods.
user_flows: Navigate to /kaprodi/dokumen-final -> Create or update a document template -> Save the template -> See the final document template list updated
Navigate to /kaprodi/dokumen-final -> Open an existing template -> Attach an academic period -> Save changes -> See the template linked to the period
Navigate to /kaprodi/dokumen-final -> Open an existing template -> Remove an academic period link -> Save changes -> See the template no longer linked

features.name: Kaprodi assessment-format management
features.description: Study program heads can manage assessment formats used across thesis evaluation workflows.
user_flows: Navigate to /kaprodi/format-penilaian -> Create a new assessment format -> Fill in format details -> Save the format -> See it appear in the format list
Navigate to /kaprodi/format-penilaian -> Open an existing format -> Update the format details -> Save changes -> See the revised assessment format

features.name: Kaprodi period and academic-year management
features.description: Study program heads can maintain the academic calendar structure used by the thesis workflow.
user_flows: Navigate to /kaprodi/tahun-akademik -> Create or update an academic year -> Save changes -> See the academic-year list updated
Navigate to /kaprodi/periode -> Create or update an academic period -> Save changes -> See the period list updated

features.name: Public thesis library
features.description: Visitors can browse completed thesis records and open individual thesis details without authentication.
user_flows: Navigate to /library -> Browse the completed thesis list -> Search or filter the results -> Open a thesis detail page -> See the thesis record details
Navigate to /library -> Browse the completed thesis list -> Open a thesis detail page -> Review the summary and available metadata -> Return to the library list

features.name: Notifications center
features.description: Signed-in users can review in-app notifications and mark them as read.
user_flows: Navigate to /notifications -> Review the notification list -> Open a notification -> See the related workflow update
Navigate to /notifications -> Review the notification list -> Mark notifications as read -> See the unread state cleared

features.name: Profile management
features.description: Signed-in users can edit their own profile information.
user_flows: Navigate to /profile -> Open the profile form -> Update personal information -> Save changes -> See the updated profile data
